parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of mutually exclusive groups in command arguments, but it introduces a new error handling mechanism that may not be ideal.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new error handling mechanism that may not be ideal. It raises a CommandError if more than one option from a mutually exclusive group is used, even if the group is not required. This could potentially break existing behavior or introduce new edge cases.
